name: interrupted-syscall
title: Retry interrupted system calls deliberately
lesson: Some system calls can fail with EINTR when a signal interrupts them; that is not always a final failure.
fix_goal: Decide which calls should retry on EINTR and implement that retry path.
fix_steps: Identify whether the operation is safe to retry.
Retry on EINTR without losing partial progress.
Re-run the lab and confirm EINTR is reported as retried.
